title: How do I best archive then remove an email account?
creator: spage63
content:
I successfully switched a family member to a new email provider. In Account Settings I moved the old IMAP email account lower, changed Account Name to "name@example.com OLD DO NOT USE", and colored its envelope red.

After a few days when I right click the old email account "name@example.com OLD DO NOT USE" and choose Get Messages, nothing happens and menu Tools > Activity Manager shows errors. I went to the old email provider's webmail interface and verified it's not getting any new emails. So in its Account Settings > Server Settings I unchecked "Check for new message at startup and "Check for new messages every X minutes".

After some cleanup its Inbox, Drafts, Spam IMAP folders are empty apart from a large "Sent" folder, but they still show up in Thunderbird's left pane.

So I think it's time to save the old email account's Sent messages in Local Folders and then delete the account.

I can't right-click to move or copy the Sent folder to Local Folders. So I guess I should create a new Local Folder "Old emails sent from example.com", then select all Sent messages, and move them to Local Folders > Old emails sent from example.com.

Then, to delete the account, do I just click the red [ Delete] button? BTW, the 9-year-old question here "How do I delete an email account in Thunderbird Mail?" is high in search results, but it is out-of-date and incorrect; it says 'Click the "Account Actions" button on the bottom left and choose, "Remove Account".' and that doesn't exist.

There should be a proper Mozilla Support answer that says how to first archive and them remove an email account. I think what I've written here is close but I welcome any suggestions and improvements.
